Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link an issue if relevant.

For a platform contribution, follow [the shared guide](https://github.com/ayovu/ranslator-screen-translator/blob/master/docs/AGENT_GUIDE.md):

- Which adapter changed? Explain why any shared UI, configuration or state logic also changed.
- List checks performed, OS/CPU/package, and platforms or scenarios not tested.
- For an optimization, include the same scenario's before/after measurements and tradeoffs.
- Mention dependencies, permissions, configuration compatibility and packaging changes.

For visible changes, attach before/after screenshots using synthetic text.
Keep unrelated features and refactoring in separate PRs.
